tha-ap371:1.1: Timirapupphiya.] Candabhāgānadītīre anusotaṃ vajām' ahaṃ / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ *sālarājaṃ va phul*litaṃ. // //
tha-ap371:2.1: Pasannacitto sumano paccekamunim uttamaṃ / gahetvā timiraṃ pupphaṃ matthake okirim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap371:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap371:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Timirapupphiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
